questions.question_text: What does the "SMART" framework for goal-setting stand for?

options.text: Simple, Motivated, Active, Realistic, Timely
Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound
Strong, Manageable, Ambitious, Reliable, Targeted
Strategic, Meaningful, Attainable, Resourceful, Timed

questions.question_text: How can connecting emotions to goals enhance motivation?

options.text: It makes goals easier to achieve automatically.
It helps you ignore setbacks and challenges.
It provides a personal “why” that fuels commitment and drive.
It ensures you never feel frustrated while pursuing goals.

correct_answer.text: It provides a personal “why” that fuels commitment and drive.

questions.question_text: Which strategy is recommended in Section 2 to overcome procrastination by making starting a task less intimidating?

options.text: The 5-Minute Rule

questions.question_text: What is a key time management tip tailored for teens mentioned in Section 2?

options.text: Focus on one task at a time instead of multitasking.
Spend all free time studying to avoid falling behind.
Avoid using planners as they are too restrictive.
Work on tasks only when you feel motivated.

correct_answer.text: Focus on one task at a time instead of multitasking.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of reframing negative thoughts, as discussed in Section 3?

options.text: To pretend challenges don’t exist and stay overly optimistic.
To replace harsh, self-critical thoughts with balanced, growth-focused ones.
To avoid thinking about personal goals altogether.
To focus only on past successes and ignore current struggles.

correct_answer.text: To replace harsh, self-critical thoughts with balanced, growth-focused ones.

questions.question_text: Which activity is suggested in Section 3 to build a habit of positivity?

options.text: Setting stricter deadlines for all tasks
Keeping a positivity journal to record daily good things and lessons learned
Comparing your progress with others to stay competitive
Avoiding reflection on challenges to stay upbeat

correct_answer.text: Keeping a positivity journal to record daily good things and lessons learned
